# Identifiers that must never be compiled into the feat binary.
#
# CLAUDE.md scope rule 3: do not hard-code the reference project's repository
# names, paths, Compose services, or database behaviour. docs/08-v0-scope.md
# repeats this: v0.1 may use hand-authored project YAML, but nothing
# project-specific may reach the domain model or the binary.
#
# Directives, one per line:
#
#   substring: <text>   fails when a Go string literal contains <text>
#   exact:     <text>   fails when a Go string literal equals <text>
#   allow:     <prefix> exempts repository-relative paths starting with <prefix>
#
# Matching is case-sensitive and applies to string literals only, so package
# documentation may still discuss these concepts in prose.
#
# Exemptions belong here rather than in a //nolint comment, so that every
# deliberate use stays visible in one reviewable place.

# Absolute and home-relative host paths. No machine-specific path belongs in
# source; paths come from configuration.
substring: /Users/
substring: /home/
substring: ~/projects

# The reference project's container mount root.
substring: /workspace/

# The reference project's external staging database selector and the dedicated
# Claude configuration volume from the example configuration.
substring: FEATURE_DATABASE
substring: feat-claude-config

# The reference project's repository IDs and Compose service names. Matched
# exactly so that ordinary English usage in longer strings is unaffected.
exact: dashboard
exact: database
exact: frontend
exact: backend
